verdict.rationale: Mileage logging and per-diem claims are a fair axis for an expense-management product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions mileage tracking, map-based distance calculation, or per-diem rates. The only related material covers general reimbursements and expense management (cards, budgets, users), which is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an employee, I can log mileage with map-based distance and claim per-diem rates without building the expense by hand
